hypothesis: A shallow exact points stratum and conditional Monte Carlo can improve team 125 rare positions while plain Monte Carlo estimates the broad matrix
estimator: For target positions 1-16, fresh P production estimates P(rank, outside A), fresh conditional-Q production estimates P(rank | A), and the estimate is their sum after multiplying Q by exact P(A). Other cells use fresh P production. Scout, pure-Q discovery, and independent validation are design-only.
decision: retain as explicit group-specific option; do not enable by default
reason: The specialized estimator improves the intended rare cells and beats the current diversified estimator over 20 seeds. It is essentially tied with equal-work plain MC on whole-table coverage, so a default rollout is not yet supported.
